course_name_en: Concepts and Proofs in Linear Algebra

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to apply proof techniques used in Linear Algebra
Identify the relationships between fundamental concepts and theorems in Linear Algebra
Ability to understand and apply geometric proof techniques

syllabus_topics: Axioms, theorems, and definitions in mathematics. Basic mathematical logic and proof techniques, Induction
How to start a proof, which steps are used, proof examples from Linear Algebra (Linear Independence, Matrix Multiplication and Cramer's Rule)
Examples of using induction in Linear Algebra
Proofs related to the concept of determinant in Linear Algebra
Proofs related to Direct Sum Spaces
Proofs related to Inner Product Spaces
Proofs related to Inner Product Spaces
Proofs related to Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
Proofs related to Cayley Hamilton Theorem
bibliography: A Guide to Proofs in Linear Algebra, Curtis Paul
Abstract Linear Algebra, Morton L. Curtis
Lineer Cebir, Arif Sabuncuoğlu, Nobel Akademi Yayınları
